info.title: stability/stable-point-aware-3d
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "stability/stable-point-aware-3d", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Comfy Router request for Stability Stable Point Aware 3D, in Stability's v2beta 3D fields sent as a JSON object. One source image is turned into one GLB and the call is billed once.

foreground_ratio.description: How much of the frame the subject fills. Default 1.3.

guidance_scale.description: How closely the result follows the source. Default 3.

image.description: A Comfy-signed asset URL of the source image.

seed.description: 0 or omitted picks a random seed.

target_count.description: Target vertex or face count. Default 1000.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description: Comfy Router output schema for Stability Stable Point Aware 3D. The GLB is generated on Comfy-hosted infrastructure and stored on Comfy storage: `model` is a Comfy-signed URL valid for up to 24 hours, not a Stability URL, so download it before then. If the model cannot be stored, the call answers 502 and is not billed; no other URL is returned. `seed` is the seed the model was generated with.

model.description: Comfy-signed URL of the GLB, valid for up to 24 hours.

seed.description: The seed the model was generated with.
